title: RF-FALCON-IDS (ROLEPLAY-only) ID ordering app with Internet Identity, live ID preview, export/print, and admin order management

requirements.text: Add persistent, on-site disclaimers across the app stating the service is ROLEPLAY USE ONLY and NOT REAL IDENTIFICATION, and ensure the ID preview/export also includes a visible ROLEPLAY-ONLY / NOT VALID ID watermark.

quotes: RF-FALCON-IDS is a high-end roleplay ID ordering and management website... It is ROLEPLAY ONLY and does not create real identification.
with clear on-site disclaimers stating ROLEPLAY USE ONLY and NOT REAL IDENTIFICATION.

acceptanceCriteria: A disclaimer is visible on the public landing page and on all authenticated pages (e.g., header/footer banner).
The ID card preview includes a watermark that clearly communicates ROLEPLAY ONLY / NOT REAL IDENTIFICATION.
Exported PNG and print output include the watermark (not just the on-page UI).

requirements.text: Implement Internet Identity authentication for all users and gate all authenticated pages/actions behind login; show a signed-out landing screen with a clear call-to-action to sign in.

quotes: Use Internet Identity for login (recommended, secure, easiest backend).

acceptanceCriteria: Signed-out users cannot access the dashboard, order form, order history, or admin panel.
Signed-in users can access the user dashboard and place orders.
The UI clearly shows signed-in state (e.g., principal / session indicator) and supports sign out.

requirements.text: Create a coherent, dark futuristic government/military visual theme with neon cyan + purple accents, glow + scan-line animations, clean professional typography, and full responsiveness across desktop/Chromebook/mobile; apply the theme consistently across all pages and components.

quotes: Dark, futuristic, government / military aesthetic
Neon cyan + purple accents
Smooth animations (scan lines, glow effects)
Fully responsive (desktop, Chromebook, mobile)

acceptanceCriteria: All primary screens (landing, dashboard, new order, order detail, admin panel) share consistent colors, typography, spacing, and component styling.
Scan-line/glow effects are present but do not block usability (forms remain readable and accessible).
Layout adapts cleanly from mobile to desktop without horizontal overflow.

requirements.text: Implement backend order persistence in the single Motoko actor: store orders keyed by authenticated user principal, enforce that users can only create/read their own orders, and support querying all orders only for admin principals.

quotes: Orders are saved with a default status of Pending and appear in the user’s order history.
Users can only see their own orders
Admin panel to view all orders across users

acceptanceCriteria: Creating an order persists it in canister state and returns an order ID.
A user querying their orders only receives orders they created (server-enforced).
Non-admin users cannot access the all-orders query (server-enforced).

requirements.text: Define an order data model that captures: ID details (first name, last name, DOB, gender, height, eye color, roleplay residential address, state, ID number), roleplay shipping info (full name, address, city, state, ZIP), a photo field (image-only), creation timestamp, and order status (Pending/Approved/Shipped) with default Pending.

quotes: Users can place an order... First name... ID number... Photo upload
Shipping Information... Shipping full name... ZIP code
Order status starts as Pending
Admin can change order status: Pending / Approved / Shipped

acceptanceCriteria: New orders are stored with status = Pending by default.
Stored orders include all specified fields and can be returned to the frontend for display.
Status values are restricted to Pending/Approved/Shipped.

requirements.text: Build the user dashboard UI: show the signed-in user’s order history list (order name/holder name, state, ID number, current status, created date) and provide navigation to create a new order and view an individual order’s details.

quotes: Each user has: Their own dashboard / Their own order history
Users can see: Order name, State, ID number, Current status

acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard renders an order list for the signed-in user and updates after creating an order or after admin status changes.
Selecting an order navigates to an order detail view that displays all captured fields (including shipping info) and the current status.
Users never see other users’ orders in the UI.

requirements.text: Build the ID ordering flow UI: an order form that collects all required ID fields and roleplay shipping fields, including a U.S. state dropdown, validates required inputs, and submits the order to the backend.

quotes: Users can place an order... by filling out a form
State selection (U.S. states only)
Shipping Information (Roleplay)

acceptanceCriteria: The order form includes inputs for every specified field and prevents submission when required fields are missing/invalid.
State dropdown includes all U.S. states.
Submitting creates a new backend order and redirects/updates the dashboard/order detail accordingly.

requirements.text: Implement state selection with state seal/logo support: selecting a state updates the ID card preview to show the chosen state name and corresponding seal image.

quotes: Each state has: A seal or logo (icon or image)
State seal updates automatically when selected

acceptanceCriteria: Changing the selected state updates the preview’s displayed state and seal immediately.
All 50 U.S. states have an associated seal asset referenced by the app.
If a seal asset is missing, the UI shows a clear fallback (e.g., placeholder) without breaking the form.

requirements.text: Add photo upload (image-only) with client-side validation and an auto-crop flow to an ID-photo aspect ratio; display the cropped photo in the live ID card preview and include it in export/print.

quotes: Photo upload (image only)
Auto-crop to ID photo ratio
Displays directly on the ID card preview

acceptanceCriteria: Non-image files are rejected with an English error message.
Users can crop the uploaded image to the required aspect ratio and confirm the crop.
The confirmed cropped photo renders in the ID preview, exported PNG, and print output.

requirements.text: Create a live digital ID card preview component that updates as the user types and includes name, photo, state + seal, DOB, gender, height, eye color, ID number, and a subtle animated scan-line effect; ensure it visually resembles a secure ID card while remaining readable.

quotes: Live preview updates as the user types
Animated scan line effect
Looks like a real secure ID card

acceptanceCriteria: All specified fields appear in the preview and update in near real-time as form inputs change.
Scan-line animation is visible and smooth, and can be paused/disabled automatically for reduced-motion preferences if supported.
Preview remains legible on mobile and desktop.

requirements.text: Implement Export & Print: allow users to export the ID card preview as a PNG image and print the ID cleanly, ensuring exported/printed output contains only the card (no surrounding UI).

quotes: Export their ID card as a PNG image
Print the ID card cleanly
No UI elements visible on export/print

acceptanceCriteria: A user can export a PNG that matches the card preview content (including photo + state seal + watermark).
Print view/output contains only the card content without app navigation or form controls.
Export/print works for at least one full order flow end-to-end in the UI.

requirements.text: Implement admin access via Internet Identity (no password): configure a backend admin allowlist of principals; add an Admin Panel UI that is visible/accessible only to admin principals and allows viewing all orders and updating any order’s status to Pending/Approved/Shipped.

quotes: An admin login ... unlocks an admin panel to view all orders... and update order statuses to Pending, Approved, or Shipped
Use Internet Identity for login (recommended, secure, easiest backend).

acceptanceCriteria: Non-admin users cannot open the Admin Panel route and receive an authorization error if they attempt admin backend calls.
Admin can view a list/table of all orders including: username/principal (or display identifier), ID holder name, state, ID number, shipping info, and status.
Admin can change an order’s status; the change is persisted in the backend and reflected on the user’s dashboard/order detail after refresh/reload.

requirements.text: Use React Query for data fetching/caching and ensure key flows invalidate/refetch appropriately (create order, update status) so UI stays in sync with backend state.

quotes: Status updates instantly reflect for users

acceptanceCriteria: After creating an order, the dashboard order list updates without requiring a manual hard refresh.
After admin updates an order status, the updated status is visible to the user after a normal reload and is reflected promptly in the admin panel list.
React Query keys are organized so user-orders and all-orders queries do not leak data between contexts.

requirements.text: Add basic safety/clarity copy in English throughout the UI to avoid confusion with real identification (e.g., on order form and export/print screens) while keeping the “secure service” presentation style.

quotes: clearly marked as not real identification
Looks like a real commercial service

acceptanceCriteria: Key user touchpoints (order form, preview, export/print) include clear English text indicating ROLEPLAY ONLY / NOT REAL ID.
No UI text claims government issuance or real-world validity.

requirements.text: Add a simple public landing page that introduces RF-FALCON-IDS as a ROLEPLAY-only service, shows the visual theme, and provides entry points to sign in and learn how the ordering process works (high-level).

quotes: The site is meant to feel like a real government / secure service
Looks like a real commercial service

acceptanceCriteria: Signed-out users see a landing page (not a blank screen) with disclaimers and a sign-in CTA.
Landing page is responsive and matches the app theme.
No ordering actions are available without signing in.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (all logic in backend/main.mo).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutable paths provided by the platform; compose them instead.
Use Internet Identity for authentication (no username/password auth).
All user-facing text must be English.
nonGoals: Implementing real-world identification creation, validation, or claims of legality.
Integrating real shipping carriers, payments, email/SMS, or external databases/services.
Third-party authentication providers other than Internet Identity.
Real-time updates via websockets (polling/refetch via React Query is acceptable).

required: RF-FALCON-IDS wordmark/logo in a dark futuristic government/military style (rf-falcon-ids-logo.dim_1200x300.png)
Set of 50 minimalist state seal icons, one per U.S. state, monochrome/duotone to match neon cyan/purple theme, consistent style (state-seals-pack.dim_256x256.png_each)
